faqs.q: Do I need to pay to try it?
faqs.a: No — the Free plan lets you draft one article end-to-end with a limited number of AI runs per month.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported for translation?
faqs.a: Uzbek, English, and Russian at launch, with more academic language pairs planned.

faqs.q: Can ArticlyApp guarantee Google Scholar indexing?
faqs.a: No — we prepare your article's metadata and check readiness, but indexing itself is Google's decision and timeline.
